evaluator_contract.complete_successful_trial_interval: Each pass evaluates n or2n equal RK4 substeps over the original total interval h; all selected counts are powers of two.
evaluator_contract.failure_equivalence: Any failed pass sets its representation flag false. The unchanged common failure tail resets published candidate and sentinels; fine executes independently even after coarse failure. firstHalfRepresented remains a redundant true term because candidateRepresented covers every fine substep.
evaluator_contract.ordinary_arithmetic_scope: n1 and2 use the original full/first-half/second-half dependency order. Division by a power-of-two count replaces the old explicit half multiplication; compiler/FP byte identity is not claimed.

exact_unchanged_source_checks: Entire common failure/error/raw-null/final-projection/controller/acceptance tail and public wrappers
Entire floor policy selector and all selected counts
Every function preceding the replaced obsolete composite helper
scope_limits: No source apply until current native batch is terminal and root selects application.
No numerical, SPIR-V-size, driver-JIT-memory or latency improvement is claimed.
Source sharing may be duplicated or otherwise transformed by the compiler and driver.
All physical1000ms, attempt/RSS/deadline, rollback/field consumers and ABI contracts remain unchanged.
True past-horizon ingoing ABI remains a distinct unresolved obligation.
